```sh
kafka completion <shell>
```

Print a shell completion script for bash, zsh, or fish

## Arguments

| Argument | Description                                          |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `shell`  | the shell to generate a script for (bash\|zsh\|fish) |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Writes completion for the selected shell; it does not load cluster configuration.

## Examples

```sh
kafka completion bash
kafka completion zsh
kafka completion fish
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

```text
# shell completion script (shell-specific)
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `2`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
